outcome: Cessation of exclusive breastfeeding at 1, 3, and 6 months
cohort: 529 full-term singleton pregnancies in a tertiary hospital
finding: Planned cesarean birth without oxytocin was associated with a higher risk of cessation of exclusive breastfeeding at 1, 3, and 6 months of life.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean birth without oxytocin is associated with the cessation of exclusive breastfeeding at 1, 3 and 6months of life.
